issues: Broken Markdown structure: in the original, "Menimbang:" and "Mengingat:" are followed by Markdown line breaks (two trailing spaces) before list items; in the translation these line breaks are missing, which can merge the label with the first list item in some Markdown parsers (e.g., "Considering:" and "In View of:" should preserve the line break).

Scrambled/merged numbering line: the original has a standalone page marker "2 2015" on its own line, followed by "Mengingat:"; the translation merges them into one line ("2 2015 In View of:"), altering the structure.
Leftover non-legal commentary at the end of the translation: "This excerpt sits under: DECIDES:" is not in the original text.

Meaning drift/omission: the standalone text "5 2015", "6 2015", "7 2015", "8 2015" appears to be page numbering in the original and should be preserved exactly; translation preserved it, but ensure no extra text is added around it (remove the added commentary only).

Meaning drift: the standalone text "5 2015", "6 2015", "7 2015", "8 2015" are page/printing artifacts and were left untranslated; they should be removed from the legal text to avoid downstream misinterpretation.

Scrambled/incorrect numbering: the final line "2. Ketentuan Pasal 2 diubah..." is a new numbered item that should not be part of Article 1’s definition list; it appears to be the start of a different provision and should be separated from Article 1 content (at minimum not merged into the Article 1 list).

Scrambled/merged list markers: multiple items run together without required spacing/newlines (e.g., 'ande. empowerment', 'and/orf. other violence', 'andg.', 'andc.'), which can break downstream list-boundary parsing.

Meaning drift/typo: 'dane.' in the original is rendered as 'ande.' (missing space) and several 'dan/atau'/'dan' conjunctions are merged into the following list item marker; needs separation to preserve structure.
Broken numbering/paragraph marker: Article 43 paragraph (2) is merged into the page number line ('12 2015 (2) ...') instead of appearing as a separate '(2)' paragraph item.
Scrambled numbering in Article 43: paragraph (2) is formatted as a standalone “(2)” line instead of “2.”, breaking the original list/numbering structure.

Minor meaning drift/terminology: “Keputusan Lurah Desa” is translated as “Village Head Decree”; it should refer to the Village Head (Lurah) decree/decision consistently (better rendered as “Village Head (Lurah) Decree/Decision”).

Scrambled/merged list structure: several markers and their content are run together on one line (e.g., "Sufficiently clear Item 2", "Sufficiently clear Item 5", "Letter b ... Letter c ..."), which breaks downstream boundary splitting and obscures the original structure.

Minor meaning drift/term choice: "Visum et Psikiatrikum" is defined as issued by a "Doctor Ahli Jiwa" (psychiatric specialist); translating as "Psychiatrist" is acceptable, but better rendered as "psychiatric specialist doctor" to match the original phrasing.
Broken numbering/list structure: in the original, "Angka 2" appears on the same line after "Cukup jelas" for Pasal 1; translation split it into a separate line, altering the marker sequence/boundary.
Broken numbering/list structure: in the original, "Cukup jelas Angka 5" appears on the same line after Pasal 6; translation split "Item 5" onto a new line.

Broken numbering/list structure: in the original, "Cukup jelas Angka 6 Cukup jelas Angka 7" appears as a continuous sequence; translation separated these into multiple lines, changing marker adjacency.
Broken numbering/list structure: in the original, "Huruf b ..." continues directly with "Huruf c ..." on the same line; translation inserted a line break between them.
Broken numbering/list structure: in the original, "Cukup jelas 6 2015 Angka 13" appears on one line; translation split "6 2015 Item 13" onto a new line.
Meaning drift in signature block abbreviations: "a.n." and "u.b." were mistranslated as "o.b." and "f.o."; should be rendered as "on behalf of" and "for/on behalf of" respectively.

Meaning drift in signature block: "u.b. Asisten Pemerintahan Kepala" mistranslated as "for the Government Assistant Head"; should reflect "for/on behalf of the Head of Government Affairs Assistant" (Asisten Pemerintahan).
